Creighton Bluejays struggles significantly with perimeter defense and interior rebounding against elite competition. Playing on their home court provides Gonzaga with a distinct advantage that fuels their offensive rhythm. Creighton will likely keep the game competitive early through transition offense, but their depth falters late. Ultimately, Gonzaga pulls away in the second half to secure both the outright victory and cover the spread.

Over Under: Both programs prioritize a rapid transition pace and generate high possession counts per game. Their impressive early-season effective field goal percentages point directly toward an efficient scoring environment. Therefore, the combined final score easily surpasses the posted total of 159.5 points.

Splits: Based on current public betting tendencies, roughly 68 percent of spread wagers and 75 percent of moneyline bets are backing the Gonzaga Bulldogs at home. Meanwhile, the point spread has moved slightly from an opening line of -5.5 to -6.5, and the total has climbed one point from 158.5 to 159.5.
